note: Single-pass extraction by Claude reading the paper text; evidence references sections/figures/tables. No multi-run validation.

components.description: Intent-to-CAD problem, HiCAD dataset and two-stage framework (CMTA then SARL), with empirical validation

nodes.name: Reconstruction pipelines presuppose a CAD model
nodes.description: Existing Image-to-CAD and Point Cloud-to-CAD pipelines use renderings, photos or 3D scans as input, which presuppose the target CAD model already exists in the physical or virtual domain.

nodes.name: Conceptual design lacks existing models
nodes.description: In early conceptual design CAD models do not exist and design intent is unstructured and incomplete, a generative demand that reconstruction pipelines do not address.

nodes.name: Three core challenges
nodes.description: Mapping hand-drawn sketches and text to CAD code faces asymmetric alignment between sketches and text, logical consistency (minor deviations cause compile failures or geometric distortion), and sparse feedback where cross-entropy fails to capture geometric fidelity.

nodes.name: No dataset covers all three modalities
nodes.description: No publicly available dataset jointly contains CadQuery code, hand-drawn sketches and textual descriptions.

nodes.name: HiCAD dataset built from DeepCAD
nodes.description: HiCAD restructures DeepCAD, using CAD-Recode CadQuery code, synthetic hand-drawn style sketches, partial and complete text generated with Qwen3-VL-32B from code, render and geometric parameters, and removes duplicates with DINOv3 sketch similarity above 0.99.

nodes.name: Four intent-to-CAD tasks
nodes.description: Four tasks cover unimodal to multimodal intent and low to high information density: sketch-to-CAD, complete-text-to-CAD, sketch plus partial text, and sketch plus complete text.

nodes.name: CMTA stage
nodes.description: Cooperative Multi-Task Alignment fine-tunes a pre-trained VLM (Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct) with cross-entropy on interleaved data from the four tasks, mitigating single-task overfitting and promoting cross-modal alignment and positive transfer.

nodes.name: SARL stage
nodes.description: Spatial-Aware Reinforcement Learning initializes from the CMTA model and optimizes a spatial-aware reward jointly for geometric and topological consistency with GSPO, across multiple tasks.

nodes.name: HiCAD outperforms baselines
nodes.description: HiCAD outperforms general-purpose VLMs (GPT-4o, GPT-5-mini, Gemini-2.5, Claude-3.7, Qwen-VL-Max) and CAD-specific models (CAD-Coder, Cadrille) across all four tasks, with performance improving as inputs go from single to multiple modalities.

nodes.name: CMTA improves over single-task SFT
nodes.description: Replacing independent single-task SFT with CMTA improves all tasks, e.g. IoU on sketch plus partial text rises from 66.61% to 72.39%.

nodes.name: SARL improves validity and accuracy
nodes.description: Adding SARL reduces invalid rate (IR) to about 0.2%-0.4% across tasks while IoU continues to increase (e.g. sketch-only IoU 66.87% to 69.09%).

nodes.name: Joint multi-task SARL is essential
nodes.description: Applying SARL jointly across tasks substantially outperforms single-task SARL on all metrics.

nodes.name: Generalizes to real human sketches
nodes.description: On 100 real human-drawn sketches, general-purpose VLMs achieve IoU below 10%, showing poor ability to handle real sketches, which motivates the robustness comparison.

isolated_nodes.name: Baseline qualitative failures
isolated_nodes.description: General VLMs hallucinate geometries violating topological rules, while Cadrille is structurally coherent but misses fine details such as cut depths or symmetry (Fig 5).

isolated_nodes.name: CadQuery chosen as representation
isolated_nodes.description: CadQuery is used as the unified CAD representation because it is modular and interpretable for LLM code generation and has several high-quality public datasets.

isolated_nodes.name: Text2CAD descriptions unsuitable
isolated_nodes.description: Text2CAD's descriptions are generated from command sequences and are therefore unsuitable as direct inputs for generating CadQuery code, so a new description pipeline was designed.

structural_reasoning: Problem framing and challenges lead to the dataset and two-stage framework; each stage is then validated by ablation and comparison. Dataset-choice rationale items isolated.
